author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Runs a fair, YouTube-first song-request queue across platforms, using one approved Streamer.bot song lookup action and the shared overlay.
changelog: 4.1.6: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.6, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.2: initial Village Jukebox release with source-routed commands, Twitch/Kick rewards, Viewer Foundation point spending, persistent queue limits, no-repeat history, vote skipping, serialized media playback, and an original YouTube overlay path.

manifest.name: Village Jukebox

actionsProvided.name: THSV Addon - Village Jukebox - Resolve YouTube Track
THSV Addon - Village Jukebox - Settle Twitch Reward

installationSteps: Import the Village Jukebox Streamer.bot package, put the private YouTube API key in Resolve YouTube Track, and leave both actions triggerless.
Approve the resolver and Twitch reward helper, choose the command names in the wizard, and add the hosted browser source. Commands register automatically after restart.
Configure optional reward IDs, save, restart StreamBridge, preview the source, then enable playback.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstalling keeps the queue, cooldowns, and recently played songs for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Checks that song lookups, the fair saved queue, one-at-a-time playback, and replies to the right platform all work.
